Real-world incidence and risk factors of level 3 (severe) hypoglycaemia in adults with type 1 or 2 diabetes (iNPHORM, United States). Level 3 (severe) hypoglycaemia is a serious, yet preventable, complication of insulin- or secretagogue-treated diabetes. However, real-world insight into its incidence and risk factors remains limited.
